item.title: EU fines Temu €200M for allowing sale of illegal products
item.description:
📝 The online retailer said it disagreed with the decision and deemed the fine disproportionate, and was now considering available options. EU tech commissioner Henna Virkkunen told reporters that the decision was intended to send a "very strong message" to Temu. "We disagree with the European Commission's decision and consider the fine to be disproportionate," they said.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1k2ydn1rz8o

item.title: Citing 'severe' math deficits, UC faculty demand a return to SAT tests for STEM
item.description:
📝 Students and faculty walk the courtyard at UC Irvine. A UC San Diego report of soaring math unpreparedness is fueling faculty warnings that reliable testing is needed for admissions. Without standardized testing in admissions, professors said they don’t know whether incoming students can handle college-level math.
🔗 Read more: https://www.latimes.com/california/story/2026-05-27/uc-math-professors-demand-return-of-sat-for-stem-admissions
